fields.label: Drive File ID or Link
fields.description: Paste a Google Drive file id OR a share link (either this or Drive File Link). A link is normalized to the id automatically. One entry per Drive file — re-indexing updates the same record.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Auto-filled from the Drive file name if left blank.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: What kind of document this is. The first four are the controlled types a Document Request can produce — they decide the template and the code series. The rest exist so input material (an amendment, a regulation, meeting outcomes) can be catalogued and picked as a source without being mistaken for a controlled document.

fields.label: Source Process
fields.description: The BPMN process model that produced/published this document (blank for manually-indexed reference material like guidelines).

fields.label: Document Code
fields.description: Readable, citable identifier allocated at first publish — POL-0001, SOP-0004. The Drive file id is the real key; this exists because nobody cites a 44-character id in a meeting.

fields.label: Lifecycle State
fields.description: Inactive means withdrawn from use, not destroyed: the Drive file and every version snapshot are kept, and sharing is revoked so it stops appearing to staff. Reversible from the Reactivate button.

fields.label: Current Version
fields.description: Which revision the Drive file currently holds. Incremented once per publish; 0 means nothing has been published yet.

fields.label: Deactivation Reason
fields.description: Why it was withdrawn — taken from the requirement text on the request that withdrew it.

fields.label: Indexed Content
fields.description: Plain-text/Markdown of the CURRENT version, used for keyword matching by Gather Reference-style Script Tasks. Superseded text lives on Document Revision, not here. Not a semantic/vector index — see AI integration notes.
